answer: Contribution-weighted ledge accounting. Each identity's influence is capped by its verified compute the network has actually consumed, recorded on a public ledge of past work. New identities start at zero and must sustain real usage before gaining weight. This inlet of measured contribution means a clone farm pays full resource cost per identity with no shortcut. A single honest account that keeps a steady plume of activity outearns dozens of fresh clones, so honesty is strictly cheaper than duplication.
